heat_boundaries.COMBI_BOILER_SH_DHW_OUTPUT: Separate appliance space-heating and DHW heat meters; DHW operation/purge/internal-store effects retained; downstream room/tap heat not measured.
heat_boundaries.REGULAR_BOILER_OUTPUT_BEFORE_CYLINDER: Total boiler output before primary-pipe/cylinder losses; separate cylinder draw-off is not this efficiency numerator. Regular is a system layout, not old non-condensing.
heat_boundaries.CPSU_INTEGRAL_STORE: Integral primary store changes the loss boundary relative to regular boilers.

EST-CONDENSING-FIELD-TRIAL.boundary_locator: Figures 1-2; printed pp2-3 / PDF pp16-17; section 6.3 printed p22 / PDF p36; printed p24 / PDF p38
EST-CONDENSING-FIELD-TRIAL.denominator: Separately metered boiler gas on source HCV/GCV energy basis; not whole-property fiscal gas. Electricity is separately monitored and excluded from the gas-only denominator; carbon benefits ratio is a different metric.

selection.recruitment: Self-selected EST website respondents; small non-random cohort, equipment-access selection, Midlands/North West England concentration and fewer flats.

substitution.locator: Table 8 printed p22 / PDF p36; Appendix D printed p95 / PDF p109

subgroup_audit.method: Own arithmetic from published rounded table rows and one-to-one Appendix D case-ID join; source convention uses 365 days, not verified calendar lengths.

limits.short_dhw_draws: Heat meters under-record short draw-offs; the summer-DHW-only upward heat adjustment is not applied to annual tables.
limits.case_328CHI: Boiler breakdown remains in accepted annual result; no ideal-operation repair.
limits.case_325JSE: Table 10 retains a B-rated regular boiler despite executive-summary simplification. Product ratings are not field efficiencies.
limits.product_rating_metadata: SEDBUK numeric ratings are outside this handoff. The author extraction omitted CPSU rating descriptors; original Table 11 includes B-rated descriptors for both. No field-value gap is filled with product ratings.
limits.excluded_348HIG: Wider trial LPG setup issue; absent from accepted records. Does not prove every accepted fuel subtype.

continuation_2010.interpretation: Source count reconciliation unresolved; repeated/overlapping annual sets are not independent homes. No significant overall heat-efficiency improvement established; low-output points excluded in some tests. No transferable control-saving coefficient.

gas_basis.interpretation: Source GCV/HCV label is known; missing applicable calorific reference/context and gas-quality pair are not filled from generic ratios or another source family.

validation_debt.scope: Quantitative reuse beyond historical source-labelled observations
validation_debt.required: Completed case coverage, actual heating/DHW/storage/distribution and auxiliary boundaries; measurement concept D4.1 and technical evaluation D6.1 are useful leads. Planned agreement is insufficient.

validation_debt.scope: Physical GCV-to-LHV or heat-to-gas-volume use of these references
validation_debt.required: Applicable calorific temperature/context, compatible gas-quality pair and volume state; no synthetic basis, generic ratio or TABULA/FGSZ borrowing.

Source-compatible service/system boundary and defensible target calibration/representative inference with uncertainty. No universal private bills, measured ageing, exhaustive census or full-calendar-year requirement.

validation_debt.scope: Use of source aggregates, reconstructed counts or uncertainty beyond the retained native records
validation_debt.required: BOILeff aggregation/weights, UK contradictory substitution prose, 2010 count reconciliation and full metrological uncertainty remain unresolved. Not a gate on retaining correctly labelled historical records.

allowed_next_use: Traceable historical source comparison and separately justified future qualification. No runtime adapter, Hungarian default, replacement of annual_same_service_reference/TABULA or gas-quality controls, national weights, source-low/high engine, task acceptance or readiness increase.
